name: Verde River (Wild & Scenic: Beasley Flat to Childs)
gaugeName: Verde River near Camp Verde, AZ
blurb: Verde Scenic River section through the Mazatzal country: Class II-IV rapids including Verde Falls. Experienced boaters only (Prescott NF).

sections.notes: AZ State Parks Paddle Map 2 (2006-07): Beasley Flat Mile 0.0 to Childs River Access Point Mile 17.2; rapids 'ranging from Class I to Class IV'; Verde Falls Rapid (Class IV, Mile 2.5, 8-foot ledge), Pre-Falls (III), Palisades (III), Bull Run (III), Bushman (III), Big Pink (III), Black Hole (III). Prescott NF: Wild & Scenic stretch 'recommended only for experienced boaters'. Group size max 25 on the Scenic section. Overnight trips need a fire pan and portable toilet (forest order 03-04-06-23-25).

guideTimes.conditions: Historical guide planning range for 17 miles at its medium-flow band (500–3,000 cfs). Craft, effort and stop time are not specified. The catalog section is approximately 17.2 miles.
guideTimes.sourceName: Arizona State Parks-hosted Verde River Paddle Map 2 (2006–2007 guide)

sections.mapPendingReason: Childs River Access Point (Verde): The only agency coordinate is for the Childs dispersed camping area; the current Coconino page does not mention boating, and the boating statement comes from a 2006-07 paddle guide.
